Module com.example.sudoku_game
Package com.example.sudoku_game.model.interfaces

Interface ISudoku

All Known Implementing Classes:
Sudoku
public interface ISudoku
Interface defining the operational contract for the core Sudoku mathematical engine. It establishes rules for a 6x6 grid grid system, including matrix layout generation, coordinate mapping, placement rule validations, assistance calculations, and backtracking terminal solution evaluations. * @author Alejandro Valencia

  • Method Details

    • generateBoard

      void generateBoard()
      Generates a playable, randomized 6x6 Sudoku board layout matrix. This method builds the puzzle infrastructure by populating specific starting coordinate clues while keeping cell constraints legally valid.

    • isValidMove

      boolean isValidMove(int row, int col, int value)
      Checks if a numerical token value can legally be placed onto the board matrix coordinates without violating the traditional row, column, or subgrid region constraints. * @param row The target vertical matrix row boundary identifier (0-5).
      Parameters:
      col - The target horizontal matrix column boundary identifier (0-5).
      value - The numerical token digit candidate attempted to be written down (1-6).
      Returns:
      true if the positioning candidate meets all local constraint rules, false otherwise.

    • getBoard

      HashMap<String,Integer> getBoard()
      Retrieves the current interactive runtime representation layout of the playable board. * @return A HashMap linking string coordinates format ("row,col") to their current visible integer values. Empty cells are represented by the absence of their key.

    • updateCellValue

      void updateCellValue(int row, int col, int value)
      Forcefully overrides or writes down a numerical value token onto specific grid matrix coordinates. Does not trigger historical validation routines or evaluation status metrics. * @param row The target vertical matrix row index identifier (0-5).
      Parameters:
      col - The target horizontal matrix column index identifier (0-5).
      value - The numerical value token to be saved onto the location.

    • validateAndPlace

      boolean validateAndPlace(String coordinate, int value)
      Evaluates a user interaction input candidate on a specific cell coordinate. If the value is mathematically correct according to the board solution, it places it onto the board tracker and updates state metrics. * @param coordinate The serialized string key identifier for the target cell location (e.g., "3,4").
      Parameters:
      value - The numerical token attempt supplied by the active input source.
      Returns:
      true if the number choice is mathematically correct, false if it is a mismatch mistake.

    • getHelpValue

      int getHelpValue(String coordinate)
      Extracts the single correct mathematical numerical answer for a specific targeted coordinate cell. Used by hint systems to automatically reveal a single valid value on the player board. * @param coordinate The serialized string key identifier of the cell needing assistance (e.g., "1,2").
      Returns:
      The correct legal integer digit matching the solution map for that location.

    • isGameFinished

      boolean isGameFinished()
      Evaluates whether the game session has been completely solved and filled successfully. * @return true if every coordinate cell contains its exact matching correct mathematical solution, false if empty slots or mistakes remain active on the grid layout.

    • getFullSolution

      HashMap<String,Integer> getFullSolution()
      Retrieves the fully pre-calculated solution matrix structure for the current game layout session. Typically generated behind the scenes using backtracking algorithms stack processes. * @return A complete HashMap linking all string coordinates format keys to their terminal solution integer results.
